why: Sizes handed to a part through a name, which no regex on the part's tag can read (MAR-3608, DS8): a Button stretched into a row by an object's member that leaves its slice through an index under another name and the @/ alias, a pick row's text size returned by a function imported by a relative path, a Notice shrunk by a constant, and a picker's trigger resized in place on a wrapper the drift rules don't know. The quiet constant and the glyph's own size inside a prop must not count. Runs with the repo's own scripts/guards/sizes-in-constants.json, whose allowlist entries are reported stale here, as they should be.
